title: EXP-07 Authoritative Protocol Freeze and Implementation Contract

experiment_identity.experiment_name: Sentinel-1 OPS-01 Multiclass Phenomenon Segmentation Baseline

radiometric_domain.truth_statement: Physical Sentinel-1 radiometric calibration is NOT identical to the OPS-01 aggregated preprocessing approximation.
radiometric_domain.stored_source_quantity: 10x10 spatial block-mean of detected amplitude, stored as float32 in OPS-01 crops
radiometric_domain.derived_preprocessing_quantity: Log1p transformed amplitude DN: z = log(1 + DN)
radiometric_domain.model_input_quantity: Standardized float32 tensor [B, 1, 256, 256] using TRAIN-only mean 4.2756 and std 0.3866
prohibitions: DO NOT claim calibration is exact
DO NOT claim error is globally bounded at 20-30%
DO NOT claim approximation error is justified by Sentinel-1 instrument accuracy specification

validity_and_nodata_policy.source_mask_integrity: Source mask PNG files on disk remain completely unmodified
validity_and_nodata_policy.runtime_mask_separation: Runtime validity mask is strictly decoupled from ground-truth source annotation masks
validity_and_nodata_policy.topology: Exclusively left-swath boundary padding columns (col 0-6 or 0-20); interior zeros = 0

dataset_interface.output_semantics: Raw unnormalized logits (no activation in model head)

excluded_classes.reason: Deficient sample size (4 tiles, 1,702 pixels, 0.0005% of dataset)

taxonomy_and_class_mapping.hm_naming_invariant: Artificial / Anthropogenic Objects (renaming to Vessel is strictly forbidden)
taxonomy_and_class_mapping.os_exclusion_invariant: Class 14 (OS) is strictly excluded from training due to deficient sample size

sampler_specification.sampling_method: Categorical sampling with replacement according to p_hybrid
sampler_specification.parent_balanced_formula: p_parent(i) = 1.0 / (12 * N_parent_k) for tile i in parent k
sampler_specification.class_presence_formula: s(i) = sum_{c in C_i} (1.0 / T_c); p_presence(i) = s(i) / sum(s)
sampler_specification.deterministic_replay: RNG seeded at start of each epoch

architecture_specification.normalization_contract_decision: Keep BatchNorm2d as the baseline architecture contract to preserve ImageNet pre-trained encoder weights. To mitigate small-sample running statistics instability (72 tiles / batch_size=8 = 9 batches/epoch), implementation must use gradient accumulation (steps=2, virtual batch_size=16) and set BatchNorm momentum=0.05.

normalization_pipeline.zero_leakage_guarantee: DEV and HOLDOUT strictly excluded (0 pixels used)

vertical_flip_azimuth.rationale: Satellite along-track flight direction preserves radar backscatter and Doppler symmetry

horizontal_flip_range.rationale: Swaps near-range and far-range incidence angle geometry; unvalidated for asymmetric phenomena

rotations_90_deg.rationale: Swaps range and azimuth axes, violating physical SAR resolution and speckle correlation differences

brightness_contrast_jitter.rationale: Artificially distorts physical radar backscatter levels, violating radiometric calibration preservation

elastic_deformation_blur.rationale: Distorts physical speckle texture and point-target sharpness critical for Artificial Objects

multiclass_evaluation_contract.masking_rule: Evaluate metrics strictly on valid pixels (validity_mask == True)
multiclass_evaluation_contract.absent_class_handling: Classes with zero true pixels in an evaluation tile/split are excluded from the macro average denominator
multiclass_evaluation_contract.background_handling: Background (class 0) reported both included (mIoU_all) and excluded (mIoU_phenomena)

holdout_epistemic_status.disclosures: Holdout remains selection-influenced due to historical phase selection and must permanently be reported with epistemic caveat.
